Nannan hears their conversation and interaction, then walks over.

[Question]
What do you think Nannan is thinking now?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Nannan thinks Dongdong and Xixi just want him to fix the car.
B. Nannan is considering possible travel plans.

D. Nannan thinks Dongdong and Xixi might be interested in his professional car repair knowledge.
